question: What is total payment volume by rail type for successful payments?
expected_sql: SELECT pa.rail_type, SUM(p.amount) AS tpv FROM payments p JOIN payment_attributes pa ON p.rail_ref = pa.rail_ref WHERE p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY pa.rail_type ORDER BY tpv DESC
source_notes: TPV uses successful payment amount only.

question: What is payment success rate for UPI payments since 2026-01-01?
expected_sql: SELECT pa.rail_type, SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / COUNT(*) AS psr, COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM payments p JOIN payment_attributes pa ON p.rail_ref = pa.rail_ref WHERE pa.rail_type = 'UPI' AND p.payment_time >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY pa.rail_type
source_notes: PSR denominator includes all payment attempts.

question: Show monthly successful TPV by rail type from 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-01.
expected_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', p.payment_time) AS month, pa.rail_type, SUM(p.amount) AS tpv FROM payments p JOIN payment_attributes pa ON p.rail_ref = pa.rail_ref WHERE p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.payment_time >= '2026-01-01' AND p.payment_time < '2026-06-01' GROUP BY month, pa.rail_type ORDER BY month, pa.rail_type
source_notes: Use payment_time for payment reporting windows.

question: Count orders and successful payments for the subscriptions product area from 2026-03-01 to 2026-04-01.
expected_sql: SELECT o.product_area, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_ref) AS orders_created, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN p.payment_ref END) AS successful_payments FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON o.order_ref = p.order_ref WHERE o.product_area = 'subscriptions' AND o.order_time >= '2026-03-01' AND o.order_time < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY o.product_area
source_notes: Use LEFT JOIN when counting created orders and payment attempts.

question: Show TPV by checkout surface and authentication mode for verified high-risk users in Maharashtra since 2026-01-01.
expected_sql: SELECT o.checkout_surface, pa.authentication_mode, SUM(p.amount) AS tpv FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_ref = o.order_ref JOIN payment_attributes pa ON p.rail_ref = pa.rail_ref JOIN user_attributes ua ON p.user_ref = ua.user_ref WHERE p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.payment_time >= '2026-01-01' AND ua.kyc_status = 'verified' AND ua.risk_band = 'high' AND ua.state = 'Maharashtra' GROUP BY o.checkout_surface, pa.authentication_mode ORDER BY tpv DESC
source_notes: Distinguish user risk from payment rail risk.

question: Show successful TPV and attempts by rail type and user risk band for payments since 2026-02-01.
expected_sql: SELECT pa.rail_type, ua.risk_band, SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS successful_tpv, COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM payments p JOIN payment_attributes pa ON p.rail_ref = pa.rail_ref JOIN user_attributes ua ON p.user_ref = ua.user_ref WHERE p.payment_time >= '2026-02-01' GROUP BY pa.rail_type, ua.risk_band ORDER BY pa.rail_type, ua.risk_band
source_notes: Attempts include every payment status.

question: How many active users are there by platform plan and gender since 2026-01-01?
expected_sql: SELECT u.platform_plan, ua.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_ref) AS active_users FROM payments p JOIN users u ON p.user_ref = u.user_ref JOIN user_attributes ua ON p.user_ref = ua.user_ref WHERE p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.payment_time >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY u.platform_plan, ua.gender ORDER BY active_users DESC
source_notes: Active user means at least one successful payment in the period.

question: Which states have the highest failed payment attempts for active accounts since 2026-01-01?
expected_sql: SELECT ua.state, COUNT(*) AS failed_attempts FROM payments p JOIN users u ON p.user_ref = u.user_ref JOIN user_attributes ua ON p.user_ref = ua.user_ref WHERE p.payment_status = 'FAILED' AND p.payment_time >= '2026-01-01' AND u.account_state = 'active' GROUP BY ua.state ORDER BY failed_attempts DESC
source_notes: Account active is users.account_state.

question: Compare TPV and payment success rate across checkout surfaces for mobile_sdk and web since 2026-01-01.
expected_sql: SELECT o.checkout_surface, SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS tpv, SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / COUNT(*) AS psr, COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON o.order_ref = p.order_ref WHERE o.checkout_surface IN ('mobile_sdk', 'web') AND p.payment_time >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.checkout_surface ORDER BY o.checkout_surface
source_notes: PSR denominator must include all attempts.

question: For low-risk payment rails, show TPV by issuer and route partner for successful payments since 2026-01-01.
expected_sql: SELECT pa.issuer_name, pa.route_partner, SUM(p.amount) AS tpv FROM payments p JOIN payment_attributes pa ON p.rail_ref = pa.rail_ref WHERE p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' AND pa.risk_band = 'low' AND p.payment_time >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY pa.issuer_name, pa.route_partner ORDER BY tpv DESC
source_notes: Low-risk payment rails means payment_attributes.risk_band.

question: For low-risk users, show TPV by issuer and route partner for successful payments since 2026-01-01.
expected_sql: SELECT pa.issuer_name, pa.route_partner, SUM(p.amount) AS tpv FROM payments p JOIN payment_attributes pa ON p.rail_ref = pa.rail_ref JOIN user_attributes ua ON p.user_ref = ua.user_ref WHERE p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' AND ua.risk_band = 'low' AND p.payment_time >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY pa.issuer_name, pa.route_partner ORDER BY tpv DESC
source_notes: Low-risk users means user_attributes.risk_band.

question: Show conversion from paid orders to successful payments by checkout surface and product area since 2026-01-01.
expected_sql: SELECT o.checkout_surface, o.product_area, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_ref) AS paid_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN o.order_ref END) AS orders_with_successful_payment FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON o.order_ref = p.order_ref WHERE o.order_state = 'paid' AND o.order_time >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.checkout_surface, o.product_area ORDER BY o.checkout_surface, o.product_area
source_notes: Use order_state for paid order cohort and payment_status for payment success.

question: Which acquisition channels drove the most successful TPV among active enterprise merchants since 2026-01-01?
expected_sql: SELECT u.acquisition_channel, SUM(p.amount) AS successful_tpv FROM payments p JOIN users u ON p.user_ref = u.user_ref WHERE p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.payment_time >= '2026-01-01' AND u.account_state = 'active' AND u.merchant_type = 'enterprise' GROUP BY u.acquisition_channel ORDER BY successful_tpv DESC
source_notes: Merchant/account attributes come from users.

question: Show refunded payment amount by rail type and settlement speed since 2026-01-01.
expected_sql: SELECT pa.rail_type, pa.settlement_speed, SUM(p.amount) AS refunded_amount FROM payments p JOIN payment_attributes pa ON p.rail_ref = pa.rail_ref WHERE p.payment_status = 'REFUNDED' AND p.payment_time >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY pa.rail_type, pa.settlement_speed ORDER BY refunded_amount DESC
source_notes: Refunded amount uses payment_status REFUNDED.

question: Among verified users in Karnataka, compare PSR by authentication mode and checkout surface since 2026-01-01.
expected_sql: SELECT pa.authentication_mode, o.checkout_surface, SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / COUNT(*) AS psr, COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM payments p JOIN payment_attributes pa ON p.rail_ref = pa.rail_ref JOIN orders o ON p.order_ref = o.order_ref JOIN user_attributes ua ON p.user_ref = ua.user_ref WHERE p.payment_time >= '2026-01-01' AND ua.kyc_status = 'verified' AND ua.state = 'Karnataka' GROUP BY pa.authentication_mode, o.checkout_surface ORDER BY pa.authentication_mode, o.checkout_surface
source_notes: Do not pre-filter to SUCCESS for PSR.

question: Show average order amount versus average successful payment amount by product area since 2026-01-01.
expected_sql: SELECT o.product_area, AVG(o.order_amount) AS avg_order_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN p.amount END) AS avg_successful_payment_amount FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON o.order_ref = p.order_ref WHERE o.order_time >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.product_area ORDER BY o.product_area
source_notes: Order amount and payment amount are distinct measures.

question: Which cities have the highest number of failed UPI payment attempts since 2026-01-01?
expected_sql: SELECT ua.city, COUNT(*) AS failed_upi_attempts FROM payments p JOIN payment_attributes pa ON p.rail_ref = pa.rail_ref JOIN user_attributes ua ON p.user_ref = ua.user_ref WHERE p.payment_status = 'FAILED' AND pa.rail_type = 'UPI' AND p.payment_time >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY ua.city ORDER BY failed_upi_attempts DESC
source_notes: City comes from user_attributes.

question: For startup merchants on the starter plan, show monthly successful TPV and distinct active users since 2026-01-01.
expected_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', p.payment_time) AS month, SUM(p.amount) AS successful_tpv, COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_ref) AS active_users FROM payments p JOIN users u ON p.user_ref = u.user_ref WHERE p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.payment_time >= '2026-01-01' AND u.merchant_type = 'startup' AND u.platform_plan = 'starter' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
source_notes: Active users are distinct users with successful payments in the period.

question: Compare payment success rate for OTP or 3DS authentication across credit and debit card rails since 2026-01-01.
expected_sql: SELECT pa.rail_type, SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / COUNT(*) AS psr, COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM payments p JOIN payment_attributes pa ON p.rail_ref = pa.rail_ref WHERE pa.authentication_mode = 'otp_or_3ds' AND pa.rail_type IN ('CC', 'DC') AND p.payment_time >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY pa.rail_type ORDER BY pa.rail_type
source_notes: Card rails use rail_type CC and DC.

question: Find users in Gujarat who had successful payments in May 2026 but no successful payments in April 2026, split by risk band and KYC status.
expected_sql: WITH may_users AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.user_ref FROM payments p JOIN user_attributes ua ON p.user_ref = ua.user_ref WHERE p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.payment_time >= '2026-05-01' AND p.payment_time < '2026-06-01' AND ua.state = 'Gujarat'), april_users AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.user_ref FROM payments p JOIN user_attributes ua ON p.user_ref = ua.user_ref WHERE p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.payment_time >= '2026-04-01' AND p.payment_time < '2026-05-01' AND ua.state = 'Gujarat') SELECT ua.risk_band, ua.kyc_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m.user_ref) AS users FROM may_users m JOIN user_attributes ua ON m.user_ref = ua.user_ref WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM april_users a WHERE a.user_ref = m.user_ref) GROUP BY ua.risk_band, ua.kyc_status ORDER BY ua.risk_band, ua.kyc_status
source_notes: Negative cohort uses the same successful-payment action in both months.
